name: Tsubasa
source:
A strong-minded and selfish girl. She's a famous young lady in Usahina, so everyone at school seems to know her. Moreover, her classmates also treat her like a princess. She seems to be extremely fond of Kotarou, perhaps there's a deeper reason for it.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/03/03/tm/]Official Website[/url]]
